artworks.title: The Unsafe Tenement
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image displays an old, rustic house from an angled perspective, showcasing the detailed structure of its facade. The focus is on the building, which dominates the scene. The house appears weathered, with a thatched roof and wooden beams of various textures. An etching technique was used to create intricate lines, conveying depth and shadow. A pathway leads to the open entrance, with a shadowy interior visible. An open doorway to the left suggests another space in the structure. The color palette is monochromatic, with shades of brown and beige, creating a nostalgic atmosphere. In the distance, faint suggestions of additional structures are visible. The composition captures the aged and rustic charm of the building with precise line work and contrasting tones.

artworks.title: Street at Saverne
artworks.description: The image shows a street view from ground level, featuring a narrow, shadowed street flanked by tall buildings. The street curves slightly to the right in the distance, leading to more buildings and a faint bright area resembling open space or sky. The artwork uses controlled etching lines to depict texture and depth, with darker lines in the shadows for contrast. The color scheme is monochromatic with varying shades of black and white. A lone figure is walking away in the scene.

artworks.title: Street at Saverne
artworks.description: The image shows an old street with tall, narrow buildings. The vantage point is low, emphasizing the height of the structures. The horizon is suggested by the buildings extending into the distance. The etching technique includes textured line work. The color palette is primarily sepia with dark browns and ochres. Shadows cast by the buildings enhance the depth and perspective of the scene.

artworks.title: Street at Saverne
artworks.medium: etching on chine on Asian laid paper
artworks.description: The image displays a street scene viewed from a low angle, emphasizing a row of buildings on the right side. The perspective creates depth as the buildings recede into the distance, with the horizon suggested by the narrowing street. On the left side, the building façades show detailed, sharp lines with densely hatched shadow areas for contrast. The street curves and disappears, guiding the eye within the scene. The color palette is monochromatic with sepia tones and deep shadows that enhance the shading. Expressive brushstrokes and fine cross-hatching detail the scene, adding texture and weight.

artworks.title: La Vieille aux Loques
artworks.description: The image shows a woman seated and hunched over in a sheltered space cluttered with household items. She appears serene with her head slightly bent, wearing a light-colored bonnet and a dark dress or cloak.

artworks.title: La Marchande de Moutarde
artworks.medium: etching in dark brown on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows two women in a rustic interior or shop. The woman on the left is holding a large round object in both hands, while the woman on the right is leaning forward to receive it. Both women are wearing head coverings and long dresses. The background features shelves with jars and containers. The doorway is framed with textured stone or brickwork.

artworks.title: La Marchande de Moutarde
artworks.description: The image depicts two women shown from head to toe. They are positioned in front of a doorway, with one woman standing on the left outside the entrance, holding a basket or tray, and the other woman standing inside on the right, partially leaning forward. The woman on the left has her hair tied back and wears a long dress with elbow-length sleeves. The woman on the right has her hair covered with a headscarf and wears a long gown. The scene is framed by a textured doorway that leads into a dark interior with shelves filled with jars and containers. The background outside the entrance consists of detailed linework suggestive of a brick wall or textured architectural surface.

artworks.title: La Marchande de Moutarde
artworks.medium: etching in black grey greenish fleck wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows two women in an arched doorway. The woman on the left is angled towards the other. She has her hair in a bun and is wearing a patterned dress. The woman on the right is facing the left. She is wearing a gown and a bonnet. The interior has shelves and containers. The exterior has rustic brickwork.

artworks.title: The Kitchen
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an interior scene with a figure near a window. The composition depicts a narrow room with textured walls. The floor is lined with crosshatches. To the left, shelves with various vessels are visible, while on the right, another surface holds what appears to be open books or papers. At the end of the room, a tall figure stands facing away, silhouetted against the light coming through a small window covered with vines or hanging plants. The drawing focuses on light and shadow play.

artworks.title: The Kitchen
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in dark brown on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows the back view of a person in a narrow, dimly-lit room. The person is standing near a small window at the far end of the room. The person's back is visible, with hands out of sight. No facial features or hair details are visible. The person is wearing a long, dark garment. The room has shelves with round, flat objects and jugs or containers. The floor and ceiling have rough, textured lines. Light comes in through the window, illuminating the person's silhouette and the room's walls.

artworks.title: The Title Page for "Douze Eaux Fortes d'après Nature"
artworks.description: The image is an etching depicting multiple figures, mostly shown from the back. A central character is sitting, slightly obscured by the crowd. This individual has long, curly hair and a wide-brimmed hat. Surrounding them are onlookers including adults and children, facing inward. The figures are depicted from head to waist, wearing period attire from the 19th century. No specific jewelry or objects held by the onlookers are discernible. In the background, there is text in a classical font style.

artworks.title: The Slipper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketched person in a reclining position, partially visible from the shoulders upward, lying on their side with their head propped up by an arm. The person's hair is long and wavy, cascading around their face, which is shown in profile with closed eyes. They are wearing a loose piece of clothing, possibly a robe or nightgown. In their hand, they seem to be holding an object resembling a book. The background includes drapery lines and a softly shaded area, with a slipper visible on the floor near the bed or couch.

artworks.title: Seymour, Seated
artworks.description: The image features a young child seated sideways with their left leg crossed over the right knee. The child's head is turned in profile, facing left, showing short, wavy hair around their ears. They are dressed in a long-sleeved garment with a collar, a knee-length skirt, long stockings, and shoes. The child rests their hands on their knee. The background consists of hachured and scribbled lines.

artworks.title: The Music-Room
artworks.description: The image displays three people in an interior setting. Two people are seated at a table, while one person is in an armchair. The person in the armchair is seen reading a newspaper. The table is illuminated by a lamp with a wide shade. The person nearest to the lamp is engrossed in a book. The third person at the table is also reading and appears to be wearing a long dress. The background is simple, with the light from the lamp highlighting the wall's texture and shading. Framed objects or artworks are leaning against the wall on the left side.

artworks.title: Greenwich Pensioner
artworks.description: The image depicts a man sitting outdoors on a patch of grass. He is reclined with his left hand on the ground and legs extended in front of him. He wears a top hat and a suit with a vest and long pants. The man's head is slightly tilted forward. The background shows a natural setting with patches of grass and faint lines suggesting trees or bushes. The illustration is a sketch with lines indicating movement and texture.

artworks.title: Landscape with Horses
artworks.dimensions:
plate: 12.7 x 20.32 cm (5 x 8 in.)
sheet: 20.32 x 30.48 cm (8 x 12 in.)
artworks.description: The etching features a low-angle perspective of a rural scene. The horizon is depicted above center, showing a line of trees and buildings. In the background are houses with stonework, thatched roofs, trees, and fences. The scene is created using cross-hatched and parallel lines for texture and depth. The color scheme is monochromatic with various shades of brown. The foreground includes grass, weeds, and a path leading to two grazing horses in the distance. A man on a ladder against a pole is seen to the right, adding a human element. Swirling lines in the sky imply movement in the clouds.

artworks.title: Nursemaid and Child
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a person reclining in a pastoral landscape. The image shows a serene outdoor setting where a person is lying on the grass, covered with a patterned blanket or piece of fabric, near a rocky outcrop or hill. The background includes a gently sloping field with rows, suggesting plowed land or textured grass, leading to a small group of grazing animals, potentially cows, in the distance. The linework is delicate, with a sketch-like quality providing texture to the grassy foreground and the foliage of a cluster of trees to the left. The overall mood conveys tranquility and a connection to nature, with details highlighting the contours of the landscape and the intricacy of the figure's attire.

artworks.title: Thames Warehouses
artworks.description: The image shows a harbor scene with detailed etching style. Large multi-masted ships are docked along the water's edge, with tall masts. The view is from a slightly elevated angle, showing small boats on the water and figures engaging in activities. Buildings line the waterfront, with signs indicating businesses like "Rope & Sail Makers" and "Hermitage Coal and Wine." Smokestacks release smoke into the sky on the right side. The overall color palette is in sepia tones.

artworks.title: Old Westminster Bridge
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
plate: 7.62 x 20.32 cm (3 x 8 in.)
sheet: 10.16 x 22.86 cm (4 x 9 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a river with a bridge and buildings along the horizon. The brushstrokes are detailed, particularly in depicting the bridge and buildings. The style uses a monochromatic palette of black and white. Two figures on horseback are near the water's edge, interacting with a small boat. The river has sailboats and other small vessels, leading towards the distant bridge. The background includes a cityscape with buildings and trees.

artworks.title: Limehouse
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
plate: 12.7 x 20.32 cm (5 x 8 in.)
sheet: 15.24 x 22.86 cm (6 x 9 in.)
artworks.description: The etching depicts a bustling dock scene from a slightly elevated angle. The horizon is low in the composition, with ship masts extending upward towards the sky. The artwork features fine, detailed lines with cross-hatching for texture. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of brown to emphasize details of the docks and ships. Wooden boats are tethered to a pier with figures, and more ships are visible in the distance. The scene conveys activity and movement typical of a busy maritime setting.

artworks.title: Eagle Wharf
artworks.description: The image features a port area with a seated figure near the water's edge. Boats are docked to the left, with buildings displaying signs like "F. Izac Whiteley & Co." There are distant silhouettes of masts and ships, suggesting the horizon. The artwork is detailed with sketch-like etching lines defining structures, water, and elements. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of brown and black. The scene captures a working dock with rich textures and contrast, conveying a sense of stillness and industry.

artworks.title: The Pool
artworks.description: This image shows a riverside view looking towards a harbor area. The perspective is from the waterline, with a man in a boat closest to the viewer. The horizon is above the boats, aligning with the cityscape and ship masts in the distance. The artwork appears to be an etching, featuring detailed linework creating textures. The composition is primarily uncolored with sepia tones. The scene includes a dock, small boats with goods or nets, a busy dockside, and various buildings in the background, indicating a bustling setting.

artworks.title: Thames Police
artworks.description: The image depicts a busy wharf from a slightly elevated perspective, showing activity on the dock and structures along the riverside. The horizon is formed by a line of buildings with smokestacks, and the scene is detailed in an etching technique with fine lines and hatching. The color palette is monochromatic in shades of sepia. Several boats are moored with people in 19th-century clothing, and more ships with masts can be seen along the water. In the background, there are brick and wooden buildings, some labeled with signs like "Thames Police" and "Wapping Wharf." The sky is detailed with light strokes, possibly suggesting movement or light cloud cover.

artworks.title: Thames Police
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed riverside scene with activity along the waterway and surrounding architecture. The horizon is defined by buildings on the right and ship masts on the left. The scene is rendered in fine etching strokes with a sepia color palette. Closest to the viewer are boats with people engaging in dockside activities. The river is occupied by tall-masted ships, and the skyline is defined by an urban landscape with visible signage.
